offering_description.value: Chesapeake Utilities delivers natural gas, electricity, and propane to households, businesses, and industrial customers. It operates gas pipelines and local gas and electric networks, delivers fuel by truck, and generates electricity and steam.

primary_products.value: Natural gas; electricity; propane; industrial steam

primary_services.value: Natural gas pipeline transportation; mobile natural gas delivery; propane tank installation

customer_segment.value: B2C: Households that use natural gas, electricity, or propane; B2B: Commercial facilities, industrial plants, local gas utilities, and pipeline operators

end_markets.value: Residential energy; commercial buildings; industrial manufacturing; gas and electric utilities

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Metered gas and electricity delivery and pipeline transportation charges; product sales: Natural gas, electricity, propane, and industrial steam; project or contract: Reserved pipeline capacity, mobile gas supply, and contracted electricity and steam delivery
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Delivers wholesale gas, electricity, and propane to homes, businesses, and industrial facilities; asset operator: Runs gas pipelines, electric networks, and a cogeneration plant serving utilities, retail customers, and industry; service provider: Transports compressed natural gas by truck for utilities, pipeline operators, and industrial users

geography_served.value: US national: Utility operations in the Mid-Atlantic and Florida, gas operations in Ohio, and mobile gas delivery across the U.S.

specialization.value: related lines: Natural gas distribution and transmission, electric distribution and generation, propane delivery, and mobile gas supply

distribution_channels.value: other: Local gas mains, electric distribution lines, transmission pipelines, and company-operated fuel trucks; direct sales: Utility accounts and contracts with commercial, industrial, and wholesale customers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State utility commissions oversee retail rates and service territories, and FERC regulates interstate gas transmission.
